crossRefs.note: But if her father forbids her in the day that he hears, none of her vows or of her pledges with which she has bound her…
But if her husband forbids her in the day that he hears it, then he makes void her vow which is on her and the rash…
But if her husband made them null and void in the day that he heard them, then whatever proceeded out of her lips…
“ ‘If anyone sins, in that he hears a public adjuration to testify, he being a witness, whether he has seen or known…
There is neither Jew nor Greek, there is neither slave nor free man, there is neither male nor female; for you are all…

translations.web: But if he makes them null and void after he has heard them, then he shall bear her iniquity.”
translations.bsb: But if he nullifies them after he hears of them, then he will bear her iniquity.”
translations.kjv: But if he shall any ways make them void after that he hath heard them; then he shall bear her iniquity.
translations.asv: But if he shall make them null and void after that he hath heard them, then he shall bear her iniquity.
